# Component properties

Figma component property types: **VARIANT** (a choice that changes the look, stored as a variant set), **BOOLEAN** (show or hide a layer), **TEXT** (editable copy), **INSTANCE_SWAP** (replace a nested instance). Variables, Styles and component properties are three different mechanisms: a Variable holds a value, a Style bundles text or effect settings, and a property exposes a choice on one component (see the preview).
